13 Oct
Smoking Cessation with Simcoe Muskoka District Health Unit Library Happenings

7:00 PM| 5482 Highway 12 S

Did you know that just 20 minutes after quitting smoking, your blood pressure and pulse begin to return to normal? After one year smoke-free, your risk of a heart attack is reduced by 50%, and quitting smoking can add up to 10 years to your life. 

Annette, a Public Health Nurse from Simcoe Muskoka District Health Unit, will share information about quitting smoking, discuss available community resources, and answer your questions. Whether you're thinking about quitting, supporting someone who is, or simply wanting to learn more, everyone is welcome. 

Every quit attempt brings you one step closer to quitting for good. Come join us and learn!

Improv 101 (Ages 55+) Library Happenings

1:00 PM| 5482 Highway 12 S

Fri., Oct. 23 1-2:30 PM | Cost: $20 per person
Join us for a fun and engaging introduction to improv, designed especially for adults 55 and up.   Led by Mike Davidson, an improv teacher with over 20 years of experience, this relaxed workshop will use simple games and activities to encourage creativity, laughter, spontaneity, and connection. No experience is necessary—just come along, meet some new people, and discover how much fun improv can be.
